scripts.format: prettier --write . && cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml && git ls-files -z -- '*.c' '*.cc' '*.cpp' '*.cxx' '*.h' '*.hh' '*.hpp' '*.hxx' | xargs -0 -r clang-format -i
scripts.format:check: prettier --check . && cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml -- --check && git ls-files -z -- '*.c' '*.cc' '*.cpp' '*.cxx' '*.h' '*.hh' '*.hpp' '*.hxx' | xargs -0 -r clang-format --dry-run --Werror
scripts.prepare: git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1 && git config core.hooksPath .githooks || true
